newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS shares surge as 9-month profits jump.
newsitem.headline: PGS shares surge as 9-month profits jump.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian seismic and offshore services company Petroleum Geo-Services soared more than nine percent on Thursday after the company released better than expected results for the first nine months of the year.

The share surged to a high of 236 crowns, a gain of 23.50 crowns on the day, after the company posted a 34 percent rise in pre-tax profits from a year ago to 362 million crowns compared with 270 million crowns.
AT 1311 GMT prices had dropped back to 230 crowns, 17.50 crowns up.
Analysts had expected profits before tax of around 336 million crowns.
Earnings per share rose to 9.39 crowns from 6.91 crowns.
